reply_poor.title: Dialogue Tip
reply_poor.message: Your reply was too short or repetitive. Try a more thoughtful response. Trust decreased slightly.

cocktail_failed.title: Mixing Tip
cocktail_failed.message: Mix failed. Try learning more about the guest's true emotions. Tip: true emotions are often hidden beneath surface emotions.

trust_low.title: Trust Tip
trust_low.message: At low trust, guests hide their true emotions. Keep talking sincerely to raise trust.

trust_medium.title: Good News
trust_medium.message: Trust increased. The guest is starting to express themselves more naturally.

trust_high.title: Trust Breakthrough
trust_high.message: The guest fully trusts you now. This is a good time to judge their true state more directly.

emotion_hint.title: Emotion Reading
emotion_hint.message: Surface emotions are only the top layer. The key is reading the true state. Correct guesses lead to successful mixes.

recipe_repeat.title: Recipe Repeated
recipe_repeat.message: This recipe has already been used. Try a different emotion combination.

guess_success.title: Guess Successful!
guess_success.message: Great job! You correctly identified the guest's emotions and unlocked new emotion elements.

guess_failed.title: Guess Failed
guess_failed.message: Not quite. Those are not the guest's true emotions. Trust dropped significantly...

emotion_changed.title: Emotion Shift
emotion_changed.message: After the drink, the guest's emotions seem to have shifted subtly.

emotion_improved.title: Emotion Improved
emotion_improved.message: This drink reached the guest. Their emotions are moving in a positive direction.

dialogue_excellent.title: Excellent Dialogue
dialogue_excellent.message: Your reply made the guest feel deeply understood. Trust increased greatly.

dialogue_good.title: Good Dialogue
dialogue_good.message: The guest felt your care. Keep the conversation sincere.
